senses.gloss: म्लक्त म्लक्त (?), अस्, आ, अम्, stolen.

म्लक्ष् म्लक्ष्, cl. 10. P. म्लक्षयति,
to cut, divide.

म्लात म्लात, म्लान, म्लायिन्, म्लास्नु. See
col. 3.

म्लात, अस्, आ, अम्, faded, withered; made white
by tanning (said of leather).

म्लान, अस्, आ, अम्, withered, faded; wearied,
weary, wan; languid, languishing; enfeebled, ema-
ciated, faint, feeble, weak; dispirited, dejected, sad,
downcast, melancholy; foul, dirty [cf. मल]; black,
dark-coloured; (अम्), n. a withered or faded state,
withering, fading; absence of brightness or lustre.
—म्लान-क्षीण, अस्, आ, अम्, withered and lan-
guishing.
—म्लान-ता, f. witheredness, the state of
being faded; the being out of spirits; lassitude,
languor.
—म्लान-मनस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, depressed in
mind, dispirited.
—म्लान-वक्त्र, अस्, आ, अम्, hav-
ing a downcast countenance.
—म्लान-स्रज्, क्, क्, क्,
having a withered or faded garland.
—म्लानाङ्ग
(˚न-अङ्˚), अस्, ई, अम्, having enfeebled limbs, weak-
bodied; (ई), f. a woman during the menses.
—म्ला-
नेन्द्रिय (˚न-इन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, having enfeebled
senses.

म्लानि, इस्, f. withering, fading, decay; languor,
faintness, lassitude, weariness, emaciation; growing
thin; dejection, sadness; foulness, filth.

म्लायत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, fading, withering; lan-
guishing.
—म्लायद्-वक्त्र, अस्, आ, अम्, having a
haggard or sorrowful face, having an emaciated
appearance.

म्लायमान, अस्, आ, अम्, fading, withering, lan-
guishing.

म्लायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, becoming faded or withered;
growing thin or emaciated.

म्लास्नु, उस्, उस्, उ, becoming faded or withered;
growing thin or emaciated.
